cross_checks.finding: Normal PreToolUse calls zulassen() but deliberately emits no deny/block response; the only explicit deny in this dispatch span is the session-bound DIGITAL-SEBUKKU path.

Function calls are queued until response.done; non-completed responses clear them, and barge-in clears pending calls before truncate/cancel, preventing pre-dispatch execution from an interrupted response.
evaluate_head resolves dependencies from the central DAG and returns NOT_COMPUTED/value=null before compute_fn for COMPUTE_OFF, unknown or taint-blocked heads.

When PresenceBridge is absent or yields no user_present value, proactive voice currently falls back to user_present=True. This converts missing evidence into positive presence and must not survive into Frankenstein 2.0.

The historical AgentLoop/ToolExecutor path had real pre-execution approval denial for non-safe tools, followed by execution only after approval; however caller-controlled skip_approval and a hand-maintained safe-name set weaken it as a successor authority model.

Approval requests receive a generated approval_id and are tracked by that id, but the inspected interface does not cryptographically bind approval to immutable request bytes/generation; Frankenstein 2.0 should bind approval_id to request_digest + invocation_id + generation.

architecture_decisions.rule: No later successful state may retroactively mint an earlier authority state. In particular, EXECUTION_RECEIPT success cannot create ADMISSION_DECISION or ENFORCEMENT_DECISION.

A model/tool proposal remains cancellable while it is only PENDING_EFFECT. Cancellation of the parent cognitive turn before submission yields CANCELLED_BEFORE_SUBMIT and no EffectGate submission. Once submission may have occurred, uncertainty becomes UNKNOWN_OUTCOME rather than replay.

Bind each effect lifecycle to immutable tool_use_id or generated invocation_id plus request_digest, session_id, generation and causal_event_id. active_turns.effect_id may remain a convenience pointer but never authoritative correlation.

WorldNeed/WorldSlice and GRID cell controls inherit Perception Control semantics: COMPUTE_OFF and taint-blocked dependencies remain NOT_COMPUTED/value=null and may not be reconstructed downstream through alternate dependency paths.
Unavailable or indeterminate presence is UNKNOWN/None, never user_present=True. Proactive voice must prefer WAIT, ASK or re-observe when presence/addressability evidence is missing.

Keep VoiceSessionCapsule as an ephemeral compiled projection over canonical sources. Add generation/freshness provenance and a bounded field-selective GRID context compiler; do not turn the capsule into a second memory authority.

Recover the historical principle that risky actions are denied before dispatch, but replace name allowlists and skip_approval booleans with typed capability/effect classification plus immutable approval identity and deterministic EffectGate enforcement.

contradictions.resolution: stern.py generic effect admission is source-proven nonblocking. Whole-system enforcement remains unresolved because the separately referenced wache-koenig predecessor is not pinned in the donor artifact.
PostToolUse can create VERIFIED without a PreToolUse row; downstream status consumers must not interpret VERIFIED as admitted-and-enforced.
Realtime proactive arbitration explicitly maps missing presence to user_present=True; 2.0 must preserve UNKNOWN.

Historical Project-Frankenstein implemented caller-side pre-execution approval while current stern generic admission is nonblocking. This is a semantic reversal/branching lineage, not a monotonic rename. Runtime reachability of every historical path remains unproven.
Canonical-main architecture_archaeology and owner-branch frankenstein_architecture_ingest remain distinct research projections; provenance must be bridged explicitly, not silently aliased.
